title: Find the French foreign name of the card with the highest converted mana co
question: Find the French foreign name of the card with the highest converted mana cost among those illustrated by Jeremy Jarvis or Aaron Miller that appear in the 'Coldsnap' set.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T2."XCL_079"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T3."XCL_099" = T1."XCL_063"
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T2."XCL_082" = T1."XCL_072"
WHERE T3."XCL_110" = 'Coldsnap'
  AND T1."XCL_002" IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller')
  AND T2."XCL_077" = 'French'
ORDER BY T1."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1
